Why such a big change on the package-lock?
shall I remove it from the patch?  Just a ton of minor version bumps created by a fresh install.

There shouldn't be these many changes in package-lock from just adding file-loader in package.json. I believe they are occurring because of node version mismatch, we should discuss and finalize one node version to be the standard for the repo

Yes, we need to come up with a plan.  I think not keeping the lockfile up to date and omitting it from pushes is bad practice... but I removed it here to not hold up this CR.

My opinion is the "standard" for Node should simply be the latest.  This project has a tendency to get stuck on deprecated versions of things.

FYI, for the large Bootstrap 5 patch I am using the latest Node/npm :https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/webui-vue/+/82993
What is it used for?
it was dump.tar added by mistake.  Removed
I assume you want https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/webui-vue/+/82993 in before this?
I was not planning on it.  If we get this in sooner I will rebase !82993 if need be.
Acknowledged
If this fails do to a package-lock change, we can look later
I +2ed this. Feel free to merge when ready, will cause a rebase of 82993.
